g.text: Note: Epoch's notable set: models with a state-of-the-art result on a recognised benchmark, over 1,000 citations, historical significance

g.text: or significant use. 242 of 1,043 models in notable_ai_models.csv record this value; the remaining 801 are absent from the chart
